_doc: PRESET: short interview, full edit (longform.py). Transcript-driven cut: pauses and um/uh removed, hand cuts, wide/tight framing that alternates at each jump cut, word-timed captions, lower third, question cards, b-roll, music bed, end card. Times: 'at_src'/'end_src' are SOURCE seconds (they follow the edit when cuts change; the studio fills them from the transcript), 'at'/'dur' are EDITED seconds. Keys starting with _ are notes.
name: interview

output._doc: aspect 9:16 | 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5 (or size [w, h]). focus = [x, y] fractions of the frame to keep in view (the face). zoom > 1 crops in for a wide camera.

trim._doc: mode: words (cut pauses longer than max_gap), head_tail (only before the first / after the last word), none. lead/tail = air kept before/after speech at a cut. fillers: cut the words listed in style/signature.json longform.fillers (transcribe with --fillers so Whisper writes them out).

punch._doc: alternate = switch between wide and tight (scale) at each jump cut; segments shorter than min_seg keep the framing. off = none.

captions._doc: mode: words (spoken word highlighted) | lines (subtitles) | off. Any key of style/signature.json longform.captions_words can be overridden here, e.g. uppercase, max_words, fixes {wrong: right}.

intro._doc: Title over the first seconds of footage. Remove the title to skip.

_titles_doc: Question / statement cards over dimmed footage: {text, label, at_src, dur}. Example: {"label": "Question 1", "text": "What makes a team work?", "at_src": 12.4, "dur": 2.6}
_broll_doc: Cutaways over the speech (sound stays on the speaker): {file, at_src, end_src | dur, from}. file = photo or video; from = start second inside a video.

music._doc: Optional bed under the speech, looped, faded, ducked when someone talks. db = level.

end._doc: Closing card appended after the edit. Set to null for none.
